description.value: Teadot is an Asian-inspired bubble tea and boba shop located inside the Nest building at UBC, serving an extensive menu of milk teas, fruit teas, matcha drinks, slushes, and sparkling beverages made with real fruit and tea. Founded in 2018 and drawing on tea culture across Asia, the shop opened its UBC storefront in early 2021 after COVID-related delays. Touring cyclists passing through the UBC campus will find a wide selection of cold, refreshing drinks available for quick pickup via online ordering.
